purpose: MAP1 acceptance specifications; not a runtime/export schema

cases.given: Same local zone number in different dimensions/layers/layouts
cases.expected: Distinct identities; alias is not an author ID
Explicit creation token per placement; no name/order/proximity matching

cases.given: Old creation callback arrives after a new world begins
cases.expected: Invalidate old world and creation token

cases.given: Native object identifier reused after destruction
cases.expected: Reject old life even if pointer/ID is reused

cases.given: Two hooks report same creation token and exact live object
Same author token links to different live objects
cases.expected: Ambiguous; never choose first or nearest

cases.given: Name/path/position match without creation source proof
Observed source has wrong revision or hash
Capture budget exceeded or callbacks lost
Multiple areas per geomorph or node belongs to wrong area
cases.expected: Exact area/zone/dimension proof and pCourseNode round trip required
